verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?

verdicts.photo_observation: Cable-route color coding matches the page-4 legend consistently across photos: an LA cable (orange line) is traced from the roof structure down the exterior wall to a ground 'LA Pit' (pages 13-18); a DC cable is shown running through a 1-inch conduit from the roof through to the equipment room (pages 11-12); and an equipment-room diagram links Inverter/ACDB/DCDB, Battery and UPS with consistent colored lines (pages 12, 16). verdicts.rationale: No orphan ends or unexplained size changes are visible within each documented segment, but full end-to-end continuity from the equipment room to the main panel isn't directly shown in a connected photo sequence, so a manual cross-check is recommended.
